offering_description.value: Perdoceo’s accredited institutions offer degree programs from the associate through doctoral levels to a diverse student population. They also provide non-degree professional development, including programming bootcamps, IT training, and medical education. The institutions deliver instruction online, on campus, and in hybrid formats, using adaptive learning tools.

quotes.quote: Perdoceo’s accredited academic institutions offer online, campus-based, and hybrid programs, providing quality education to a diverse student population. These institutions include Colorado Technical University (CTU) ® – encompassing programming bootcamp Coding Dojo ® – and the American InterContinental University System (AIUS) which comprises American InterContinental University ®, Trident University International, California Southern University ™, IT education provider DigitalCrafts, and medical education provider Hippo.

CTU and AIUS offer industry-relevant programs from non-degree professional development and associate degrees, up to the doctoral level. They utilize technologies like the award-winning Intellipath ® adaptive learning platform and CTU Mobile App.
